skills.name: movk-nuxt
skills.description: Build and maintain apps using @movk/nuxt on Nuxt 4 or Vue + Vite. Use when setting up Movk Nuxt, migrating from v1, building Zod v4 AutoForm or SearchForm schemas, configuring MDataTable columns or pagination, using Movk components, themes or composables, or integrating Nuxt APIs with useApiFetch, $api, file transfer progress or SSE chat.
